Privacy

  • Collected locally: titles, channel names and video IDs of videos you watch (15+ s) and recommendations shown, plus keyword counts.
  • Never collected: account info, passwords, cookies, comments, search queries, or anything from other sites.
  • Never uploaded: there is no server, no analytics and no network request. Data lives in Chrome's local extension storage.
  • Permissions: “storage” and access to www.youtube.com only.
  • Honesty: explanations are estimates from your local patterns. WhyFeed does not know YouTube's internal algorithm and cannot change it.
